title: Denoise
description: Self-supervised denoising of 2D and 3D microscopy images and stacks in the browser: Aydin FGR (Noise2Self boosted trees or Ridge), Zero-Shot Noise2Noise (ZS-N2N), and Anscombe VST Non-Local Means.

denoise.title: Denoise image
denoise.description: Denoise one single-channel 2D image, 3D Z-stack or 2D+T time-series without external training data, returning the denoised image (TIFF and NIfTI) and noise residual map (TIFF) with residual quality diagnostics.

image.description: One single-channel 2D image, 3D Z-stack or 2D+T stack: TIFF, OME-TIFF, ImageJ TIFF or NIfTI

method.description: fgr-gbdt: Aydin FGR with boosted trees (Noise2Self); fgr-ridge: Aydin FGR with cross-validated Ridge; zs-n2n: Zero-Shot Noise2Noise residual CNN; vst-nlm: Generalized Anscombe VST + Non-Local Means

mode.description: auto uses 3D/spatiotemporal context when the input has multiple slices or frames; 2d processes slices laterally; 3d uses neighbouring planes

nTrees.description: Maximum boosting rounds for fgr-gbdt (early stopping may stop sooner)

maxScale.description: Largest J-invariant donut ring radius in pixels for FGR methods

channels.description: Hidden channel width of the 2-layer zs-n2n residual CNN

noiseModel.description: Noise variance model for vst-nlm (poisson-gaussian applies Generalized Anscombe VST)

nlmStrength.description: Non-Local Means filtering strength multiplier h / sigma for vst-nlm

seed.description: Deterministic random seed for self-supervised sampling and CNN initialisation
